finding.claim: AGENTS.md says `just lint` and `just test` run the gates by hand, but the new integration gate has no recipe and `just test` (uv run pytest) now leaves the integration tier out, so that line is false after this change.

fixes.change: A just integration recipe runs uv run pytest -m integration, the tier the integration gate runs.
The Gates line names just integration beside just lint and just test.
